33404048.fault: x is incremented before the first judge(x), so it accumulates the length of years n+1..y instead of n..y-1 (off-by-one year), and the leap check at line 19 is applied to the accumulated year
33404048.implementedAlgorithm: accumulate day shifts year by year until shift%7==0 with matching leap status

33851993.fault: leap-status match uses n%4 / ans%4 instead of the Gregorian rule: for non-leap century n=1000 it requires ans to be a non-leap century, returning 1400 instead of 1006
33851993.implementedAlgorithm: weekday walk of years, stop at shift 0 with matching leap status

36948127.fault: fixed offsets ignore century years (non-leap 1900, 2100...) inside the interval; for n=1000 (non-leap, n%4==0) prints 1011, expected 1006

36948401.fault: n+28 is wrong when a non-leap century lies in between (1872 -> 1900 is not a leap year); non-leap branch never checks the answer year is non-leap
36948401.implementedAlgorithm: leap n -> n+28; else walk years until shift%7==0

36948709.fault: for non-leap n (x=0) it stops at the first shift%7==0 without requiring a non-leap answer (2002 -> 2008, a leap year); for leap n the mismatch fix adds a fixed +1 shift
36948709.implementedAlgorithm: walk years until shift%7==0, extra leap check for leap n
